description_ar: إعلانات قصيرة (40-85 كلمة) من إدارة الجامعة أو الأقسام أو الفعاليات. سؤالان لكل إعلان: الفكرة الرئيسية والتفاصيل/الغرض.

coach_notes_ar: 📢 الإعلان قصير - لا وقت للسرحان. ركّز من الجملة الأولى.
🎯 اسأل نفسك فوراً: من المتحدث؟ من الجمهور؟ ما الموضوع؟
📅 انتبه للأرقام: تواريخ، أوقات، أماكن، رسوم - غالباً تُسأل عنها.
🔑 الجملة الأولى أو الأخيرة تحتوي عادةً على الفكرة الرئيسية.
⚠️ احذر: قد يُذكر تغيير في آخر الإعلان (مثل تأجيل أو نقل مكان).

announcements.transcript_en: Attention students of History 201. Please note that today's lecture has been moved from Room 305 to Hall B on the second floor due to a maintenance issue with the air conditioning. The lecture will start at the regular time, 10 AM. Please arrive five minutes early to find seats.

questions.question_en: What is the main purpose of this announcement?
options: To inform students of a room change
questions.explanation_ar: الإعلان يخبر بنقل المحاضرة من غرفة 305 إلى قاعة B.

questions.question_en: Why was the room changed?
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر صراحةً 'maintenance issue with the air conditioning'.

announcements.transcript_en: This is a reminder that the main library will close two hours earlier than usual this Friday, at 6 PM instead of 8 PM, due to a staff training event. The library will resume normal hours on Saturday morning. Students are encouraged to check out books before 5:45 PM to avoid delays at the counter.

questions.question_en: What is the announcement about?
questions.explanation_ar: الإعلان عن إغلاق المكتبة مبكراً يوم الجمعة.

questions.question_en: What time will the library close on Friday?
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر بوضوح 'at 6 PM instead of 8 PM'.

announcements.transcript_en: Geology students, our field trip to the Crystal Mountains has been rescheduled from this Saturday to next Sunday because of the weather forecast. The bus will leave campus at 7 AM sharp from the main gate. Bring your hiking boots, water, and notebooks. The fee remains twenty dollars, payable at the department office.

questions.question_en: When will the field trip take place now?
questions.explanation_ar: أُعيد جدولتها 'from this Saturday to next Sunday'.

questions.question_en: Why was the trip rescheduled?
questions.explanation_ar: السبب 'because of the weather forecast'.

announcements.transcript_en: Good afternoon. The university sports center is now accepting registration for the spring fitness program. Sessions include yoga, swimming, and basketball. Membership costs fifty dollars per semester for students and includes access to all facilities. Sign up at the front desk before March 1st to receive a free fitness assessment.

questions.question_en: What is being announced?
questions.explanation_ar: الإعلان عن فتح التسجيل لبرنامج اللياقة الربيعي.

questions.question_en: What does early registration include?
questions.explanation_ar: التسجيل قبل 1 مارس يمنح 'free fitness assessment'.

announcements.transcript_en: Attention graduating seniors. The commencement ceremony will be held in the Main Auditorium on June 15th at 5 PM. Graduates must arrive by 4 PM to collect their gowns and line up. Each student is allowed four guest tickets, available at the dean's office starting next Monday. Photography is permitted only from designated areas.

questions.question_en: How many guest tickets is each graduate allowed?
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'four guest tickets' لكل طالب.

questions.question_en: Why must graduates arrive by 4 PM?
options: To collect gowns and line up
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'to collect their gowns and line up'.

announcements.transcript_en: Important notice to all students. The campus cafeteria staff will be participating in a one-day strike this Thursday to support ongoing wage negotiations. As a result, the main cafeteria and two side kitchens will be closed all day. Vending machines will remain operational, and nearby off-campus restaurants are offering a ten percent student discount on Thursday only.

questions.question_en: Why is the cafeteria closing?
questions.explanation_ar: السبب إضراب موظفي الكافتيريا.

questions.question_en: What can students likely do for food on Thursday?
options: Use vending machines or eat at discounted nearby restaurants
questions.explanation_ar: الإعلان يذكر آلات البيع والمطاعم المجاورة بخصم.

announcements.transcript_en: The Writing Center is hosting a free workshop on academic essay structure next Wednesday from 3 to 5 PM in Room 210. The session is especially recommended for first-year students preparing their first research paper. Topics include thesis development, paragraph cohesion, and citation styles. Seats are limited to twenty-five participants, so early registration through the center's website is strongly advised.

questions.question_en: Who is the workshop mainly aimed at?
options: First-year students writing their first paper
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'especially recommended for first-year students'.

questions.question_en: Why is early registration advised?
options: Because seats are limited to twenty-five
Because there is a test at the end
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'Seats are limited to twenty-five participants'.

announcements.transcript_en: Attention all university email account holders. The IT department will perform a major system upgrade this Saturday between 1 AM and 6 AM. During this period, you will be unable to send or receive emails. After the upgrade, all users must reset their passwords using the link sent to their backup email. If you do not have a backup email registered, please visit the IT help desk before Friday afternoon.

questions.question_en: What is the announcement about?
options: An email system upgrade requiring password reset
questions.explanation_ar: الإعلان عن ترقية نظام البريد وضرورة إعادة تعيين كلمات المرور.

questions.question_en: What should a student without a backup email do?
options: Visit the IT help desk before Friday
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'please visit the IT help desk before Friday afternoon'.

announcements.transcript_en: The Department of Economics is pleased to host Professor Lena Hoffman from Berlin University, who will deliver a public lecture titled 'Global Trade After the Pandemic' this Friday at 4 PM in Lecture Hall A. The talk will be followed by a thirty-minute Q&A session. Although the event is free, registration is required for non-economics students to secure a seat.

questions.question_en: What is the topic of the lecture?
questions.explanation_ar: العنوان 'Global Trade After the Pandemic'.

questions.question_en: Why must non-economics students register?
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'registration is required for non-economics students to secure a seat'.

announcements.transcript_en: Good news, everyone. The central campus garden, which has been closed for three months for landscaping, will reopen this Monday. New features include a meditation area, more benches, and a small outdoor study space with Wi-Fi access. Please respect the new plants by staying on the marked paths. The garden is open from 6 AM to 9 PM daily.

questions.question_en: What is the announcement primarily about?
options: The reopening of the campus garden
questions.explanation_ar: الإعلان عن إعادة فتح الحديقة بعد التجديد.

questions.question_en: Which is NOT a new feature of the garden?
questions.explanation_ar: المقهى لم يُذكر - الميزات المذكورة: تأمل، مقاعد، مساحة دراسة بـ Wi-Fi.

announcements.transcript_en: All students, please be aware of an updated attendance policy effective next semester. Previously, students were allowed up to four unexcused absences per course. Under the revised policy, only three are permitted, and a fourth absence will result in an automatic letter-grade reduction. Medical absences with documentation remain excluded from this count. Department heads have the discretion to apply stricter rules in laboratory or seminar courses, where physical presence is critical.

questions.question_en: What is the key change in the attendance policy?
options: The allowed unexcused absences decreased from four to three
Medical absences are no longer accepted
questions.explanation_ar: التغيير الأساسي: تقليل الغياب المسموح من 4 إلى 3.

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about lab courses under the new policy?
options: They may have even stricter attendance rules
They are exempt from the policy
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'Department heads have the discretion to apply stricter rules in laboratory or seminar courses'.

announcements.transcript_en: The Office of Graduate Studies is pleased to announce the opening of applications for the Faculty Research Grant. Up to ten graduate students will receive funding of three thousand dollars each to support thesis-related travel, equipment, or specialized software. Applicants must submit a detailed budget, a faculty recommendation, and a two-page project description by May 30th. Note that recipients are expected to present their results in the annual graduate symposium next fall.

questions.question_en: What must applicants submit?
options: A budget, a faculty recommendation, and a project description
questions.explanation_ar: المتطلبات الثلاثة ذُكرت بوضوح.

questions.question_en: Why must recipients present in the symposium?
options: As an expected outcome of receiving the grant
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'recipients are expected to present their results' - شرط متوقع.

announcements.transcript_en: Attention all biology and chemistry majors. Starting this month, lab access outside of scheduled class hours will require a new safety certification. The certification involves a two-hour online module and a brief in-person evaluation. Students who fail to complete it by the end of the month will lose evening and weekend lab privileges. The change responds to recent safety incidents and aims to ensure that all independent lab users are properly trained.

questions.question_en: What is the primary reason for this new requirement?
options: To respond to safety incidents and ensure proper training
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'responds to recent safety incidents and aims to ensure that all independent lab users are properly trained'.

questions.question_en: What will happen to a student who does not complete certification?
options: They will lose evening and weekend lab access
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'will lose evening and weekend lab privileges'.

announcements.transcript_en: Important notice from the housing office. Beginning next academic year, dormitory fees will increase by approximately seven percent to cover rising utility costs and planned renovations of older buildings. Students who renew their housing contract before April 15th will be eligible for a partial rate freeze, paying only the current rate for the first semester. Financial aid will be adjusted accordingly for qualifying students; please contact the financial aid office for details.

questions.question_en: Why is the housing fee increasing?
options: To cover utility costs and renovations of older buildings
questions.explanation_ar: السبب 'rising utility costs and planned renovations of older buildings'.

questions.question_en: What benefit do early renewers get?
options: Current rate for the first semester only
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'paying only the current rate for the first semester'.

announcements.transcript_en: This is an emergency preparedness announcement. A full-campus evacuation drill will take place this Thursday at 11 AM. When the alarm sounds, all students, faculty, and staff must leave their buildings immediately using the nearest marked exit and gather at the designated assembly points outdoors. Do not use elevators. The drill should take no more than twenty minutes. Department coordinators will record attendance, and unexcused absences may affect course participation grades for students in attendance-mandatory classes.

questions.question_en: What is the announcement about?
questions.explanation_ar: تدريب مخطط، وليس طارئاً حقيقياً.

questions.question_en: What can be inferred about students who skip the drill?
options: They may face grade consequences in attendance-mandatory classes
questions.explanation_ar: ذُكر 'unexcused absences may affect course participation grades'.
